requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (artigianato) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.
requirements.remediation: Source the artigianato rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour follows the national CCNL rule on the hours of a day of leave (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001, work_rules.parental_hourly), or without one the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter: half the average daily hours a day, two such days a day of leave, no cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.1-2.2). The run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.
Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.
